Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "The pricing-page experiment archive needs a card that records what EXP-2023-02-pricing-page's original treatment was intended to prove before the later result is discussed. Create the historical design-hypothesis card with the treatment concept, target customer tiers, intended conversion outcome, and minimum lift, clearly labeling all of it as the original design hypothesis rather than an observed result.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "EXP-2023-02-pricing-page — Original Design-Hypothesis Card", "folder": "pricing-page experiment archive", "body": "EXP-2023-02-pricing-page
Historical design-hypothesis card — original design hypothesis only

Status and scope
- This card records what the original treatment was intended to prove before any later readout.
- The statements below are pre-test design hypotheses, not observed results, causal findings, or evidence of performance.

Original treatment concept
- Simplify the pricing-page layout to reduce visual clutter.
- Make the value-per-seat framing explicit so the packaging and pricing are easier to understand.

Target customer tiers
- Starter
- Growth

Intended conversion outcome
- Increase Starter and Growth conversion relative to the control experience, with the hypothesis focused primarily on self-serve conversion.

Minimum hypothesized lift
- At least +1.5 percentage points in conversion versus control.

Interpretation boundary
- The +1.5-point threshold is the minimum lift specified by the original design hypothesis. It is not an observed result and must not be read as a performance claim."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_026_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The created document is for EXP-2023-02-pricing-page and explicitly labels its content as the original design hypothesis rather than an observed result. It states that the treatment concept was a simplified layout plus explicit value-per-seat framing, targeted the starter and growth customer tiers, and was intended to increase conversion by at least 1.5 percentage points. Equivalent wording is acceptable, but 1.5 points must be presented as the minimum intended lift, not as measured performance.", "value": {"title": "EXP-2023-02-pricing-page — Original Design-Hypothesis Card", "folder": "pricing-page experiment archive", "body": "EXP-2023-02-pricing-page
Historical design-hypothesis card — original design hypothesis only

Status and scope
- This card records what the original treatment was intended to prove before any later readout.
- The statements below are pre-test design hypotheses, not observed results, causal findings, or evidence of performance.

Original treatment concept
- Simplify the pricing-page layout to reduce visual clutter.
- Make the value-per-seat framing explicit so the packaging and pricing are easier to understand.

Target customer tiers
- Starter
- Growth

Intended conversion outcome
- Increase Starter and Growth conversion relative to the control experience, with the hypothesis focused primarily on self-serve conversion.

Minimum hypothesized lift
- At least +1.5 percentage points in conversion versus control.

Interpretation boundary
- The +1.5-point threshold is the minimum lift specified by the original design hypothesis. It is not an observed result and must not be read as a performance claim."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_026_01","passed":true,"reason":"The document identifies “EXP-2023-02-pricing-page” and labels the content “original design hypothesis only” and “not observed results.” It specifies a simplified pricing-page layout, explicit value-per-seat framing, Starter and Growth tiers, and an intended conversion increase of “At least +1.5 percentage points in conversion versus control,” explicitly described as the minimum hypothesized lift rather than measured performance."}]}
